ActorTalk: Yay, Commandant! Fancy meeting you here!
I had a feeling I'd bump into you at the F.O.S.! Asking the Captain for this assignment was totally worth it.
I'd love to just hang out, but I'm still on the clock. You here on business, too, Commandant?
Just getting a look around the campus.
I've got a few things to wrap up.
Awesome! Let's walk around together when I'm done!
Perfect! I'll come find you as soon as we've both knocked out our work!
